title: I Added 20 Cities. I'm Famous Everywhere!

lines.text: I did it! I added 20 cities to my Google Business Profile.
Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan. I'm taking over New York.
lines.why: fantasy pose holds, then everything freezes as the assistant rises

lines.text: Wait, so I'll rank number one in all 20?
Sir, this is a service area setting, not a teleportation device.
lines.why: he tries the portal; it collapses into a map pin

lines.text: Then what did I actually accomplish?
You told customers where you're willing to work.
Adding more service areas doesn't automatically improve your Google Maps rankings.
Local visibility mainly depends on relevance, distance, and prominence.
Keep your business information accurate and build a stronger local presence.

lines.why: cape appears and falls; short comedic pause
